customisationOptions.option: Add admission to both temples (Entrance Fees tier)
customisationOptions.source: The tour comes in three tiers, so you only pay for what you want: a Base package (private vehicle, guide, water, and all driving and logistics); Base + Entrance Fees (the same, plus admission to both temples); and Base + Entrance Fees & Lunch (that admission plus a midday meal).

customisationOptions.option: Arrange a gentle evening before and slow morning after
customisationOptions.source: What we can arrange is everything around it: a gentle evening before, a slow morning after, an Aswan schedule that absorbs the early start.
